items.description:
TMS-Redec is an industrial services provider based in Irene, Centurion, and a member of the Sekta Group, offering clients a comprehensive turnkey solution across a wide range of specialised trades. Its service list spans abrasive blasting and industrial-scale painting, chemical cleaning, cold cutting, concrete rehabilitation and repairs, epoxy and specialised floor coatings, fireproofing, and industrial-scale corrosion protection coatings and linings.

The company also handles asbestos removal, catalyst handling, high-pressure washing, industrial cleaning, vacuumation and waste removal, insulation and cladding, and tank desludging and cleaning, supported by Kwikstage, Ringlock and Layher access scaffolding and rope access teams for working at height. Based in Irene, Centurion, TMS-Redec suits industrial and commercial clients needing a single contractor able to combine several specialised trades on one site rather than coordinating separate subcontractors for each task.

Totai is a gas appliance company based in Icon Park, Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, trading under its own Totai brand alongside the Elba and Elica brands it also distributes. The business publishes buying guides on its blog covering topics such as which gas appliances are most efficient during load shedding, what cooking features a modern kitchen needs, and how to choose an Elica extractor fan, reflecting a focus on helping customers choose the right appliance rather than just selling stock.

Totai operates both a head office contact line and a separate service centre line for after-sales support, and sells through a digital catalogue as well as its online shop. Totai suits households and retailers across Southern Africa looking for gas cooking, heating and catering appliances backed by dedicated service support rather than a generic appliance retailer.

Uloans is an online credit provider offering short-term loans, personal loans and debt-consolidation loans ranging from R500 to R180,000, with repayment periods that vary according to the product chosen. Applications are handled digitally, so an approved borrower can access funds without needing to visit a branch for every step of the process.

The lender is associated with Ubank, which lists Uloans among its retail credit products, giving it a banking-group presence behind its lending book. It serves South African consumers, particularly permanently employed applicants needing personal finance or looking to consolidate several debts into one repayment. Based at 81 Botterklapper Street, The Willows, Pretoria, Uloans suits borrowers wanting a straightforward online application route to short-term or debt-consolidation finance rather than a traditional bank loan process.

Valuetec Property Valuers, headquartered in Rietfontein, Pretoria, provides independent professional property valuations and related advisory services, managing the entire valuation process on a client's behalf. As registered and professional property valuers, the firm produces valuation reports for commercial, agricultural, residential and specialised properties, including wine farms, drawing on a dedicated valuation team and a published valuation process clients can follow from start to finish.

Its valuations cover a wide range of purposes, including market value, sale, purchase, finance, insurance, legal matters, divorce, tax, deceased estates, depreciated replacement value, forced sale and market rental determination, with outsourced architectural photography and residential estate agent services also available. Based in Gauteng, Valuetec suits individuals and institutions needing an independent valuation for virtually any property-related purpose, legal or financial.

Venue Nouveau is a wedding venue nestled deep in the Bronberg mountains on the urban edge of Pretoria East, built around historic yet contemporary architecture where industrial black glass windows draw the natural, unstructured landscape into a modern bohemian-chic interior. The venue describes itself as kind to nature, aiming to run on an eco-ethical basis rather than treating sustainability as an afterthought.

Couples are invited to visit and visualise their day amid the venue's mountain backdrop before booking, and Venue Nouveau markets itself as a dog-friendly wedding venue, welcoming couples who want their pets included in the celebrations. Based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria East, Venue Nouveau suits couples wanting a romantic, nature-based setting for all seasons, with past clients describing the planning process as straightforward and well supported throughout.

Verimark Wonderpark is a branch of the Verimark retail chain, selling household and lifestyle products including vacuums, mops and brooms, kitchen appliances and cookware, fitness equipment and beauty devices. Shoppers can see and handle these items in person at the store rather than only browsing them online.

The branch serves general retail customers in Karenpark and the surrounding Wonderpark area looking for household, kitchen, cleaning and fitness products from a long-running national retail brand. Based at Shop 355CA, Wonderpark Shopping Centre, on the corner of Old Brits Road and Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark, Pretoria, Verimark Wonderpark suits shoppers already visiting the centre who prefer buying these everyday consumer products off the shelf.

Vibro Bricks and Paving is a manufacturer and supplier of paving and building materials in Gauteng, with more than 20 years in the industry behind its reputation for reliability and quality. Its range covers cobble, bevel and interlocking pavers, kerbs, blocks and retaining wall systems, offered in a variety of colours, textures and finishes so that each project can be matched to its own design.

Beyond manufacturing, the company provides on-site consultations and ongoing follow-up support to help see a project through, and positions itself as a socially responsible business committed to sustainable manufacturing, including the use of recycled materials to reduce its environmental impact. Operating from Zwavelpoort in Pretoria East, Vibro Bricks and Paving suits builders, developers and homeowners needing paving and retaining wall materials matched to a specific design brief rather than an off-the-shelf range.

The Victoria Hotel provides hotel accommodation in central Pretoria, with individually named rooms that reflect the building's long history rather than standard numbered units. Guests can also book its conference and function facilities, which cater for groups of up to 100 delegates alongside the traditional amenities expected of an established city-centre hotel.

Widely documented as Pretoria's oldest operating hotel, the building traces its history back to the Stasie Hotel, also known as the Station Hotel, which was renamed the Victoria Hotel during the British occupation in the late nineteenth century. It serves hotel guests, visitors to Pretoria and organisations or groups needing accommodation, conference or function space in one venue. Located at 200 Scheiding Street, opposite Pretoria railway station, the Victoria Hotel suits travellers and event organisers wanting a historic setting within easy reach of the station.

vida e caffe Hazeldean Square serves espresso-based coffee, iced coffees, teas and smoothies alongside a food menu covering breakfast, sandwiches, toasties, focaccias, wraps, salads, pastries and muffins. Customers can also buy vida coffee beans and capsules to brew the same coffee at home.

The branch serves local shoppers, commuters, and breakfast and lunch customers looking for a quick coffee or a sit-down meal, as well as takeaway and delivery customers, with the branch currently offering pickup and delivery through Uber Eats. Based at Shop 11, Hazeldean Square, on the corner of Silver Lakes and Lynnwood Road in Hazeldean, Pretoria, vida e caffe Hazeldean Square suits coffee drinkers wanting a familiar cafe menu close to home, whether dining in, collecting a takeaway order or having it delivered.

The Voortrekker Monument, in Groenkloof, is a heritage site and museum commemorating the Great Trek, with the Kruger Death Room, the Transvaal Voortrekkers Museum, the Toekomsbou Museum Theatre, the Heritage Centre, the Consolation Garden and Fort Schanskop among its key features, alongside the Pioneer Yard and on-site restaurants and shops. Tour guides are available but must be arranged in advance by email, and school groups are welcomed on a regular basis, with the Historical Trek-Route Garden and Pioneer Centre among the most popular points of interest for young visitors.

The monument is open daily from 8am to 5:30pm, with the rest of the terrain accessible slightly earlier, and closes only on 24 and 25 December, 31 December and 1 January, and Good Friday. Based in Groenkloof, Pretoria, the Voortrekker Monument suits history-minded visitors, school groups and anyone wanting a guided or self-directed look at Afrikaner heritage and the Great Trek.

WATCON GROUP, established in 1969 in East Lynne, built its early reputation on high-quality roofing and an innovative approach to waterproofing before adding a Painting and Renovations Division six years later and an Interior Decorating Division at the turn of the century. Its Waterproofing Division, with more than 30 years of specific experience, now covers pitched and flat roofs, parking decks and podiums, basements and foundations, balconies, terraces and walkways, and decorative roof finishes for both homes and commercial buildings.

The wider group also offers scaffolding erection and dismantling, rope access and cherry picker operations, ceilings and partitioning, internal refurbishments and renovations, carpentry and joinery, aluminium shopfronts and windows, light steel construction, flooring and project management. Operating from East Lynne, WATCON GROUP suits clients needing one contractor across waterproofing, painting, damproofing and structural finishing on the same project.

Weather Master, in Hennopspark, has been South Africa's pioneer in sun control since being established in 1953, and is recognised as the original inventor of the louvre awning, including the brand's signature three-blade fascia design that has become a standard reference point in the awning industry. The company manufactures and installs its own quality, durable sun control products for domestic, commercial and architectural applications.

Headed by three directors and backed by a skilled, experienced workforce, Weather Master serves customers across Gauteng, the Free State and the Northern Cape and surrounding areas, helping protect outdoor spaces from summer rain and reflecting winter sunlight back into the home. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, Weather Master suits homeowners and businesses wanting a long-established, proudly South African manufacturer rather than an imported or generic awning product.

Weldhagen Eggs produces, grades, packs and distributes Grade 1 eggs, with pack sizes ranging from 6 to 60 eggs as well as bulk boxes for larger orders. Its Egg Depot outlets also sell eggs directly to the public at wholesale prices, giving household buyers the same pricing available to commercial customers.

A family business that has operated near Pretoria since 1968, Weldhagen runs its own delivery fleet, and its Kameeldrift grading station can grade up to 108,000 eggs an hour, reflecting the scale needed to supply retailers, restaurants, hotels, hospitals and other commercial customers needing regular egg supplies. Based at Plot 143, Kameeldrift Road, Zeekoegat, Pretoria, Weldhagen Eggs suits both bulk commercial buyers and members of the public wanting fresh eggs bought directly from the grading source.

WHM Labour Law Advisors, based in Eldorette, has more than 25 years of experience in the human resources and industrial relations environment, helping employers manage disciplinary processes, misconduct investigations and CCMA matters. Its members are registered organisers at the South African United Employers' Organisation, allowing its advisors to represent companies directly at the CCMA or a Bargaining Council, a cost-saving alternative to using a separate industrial relations practitioner for ad hoc legal documentation.

A monthly retainer package gives employers ongoing legal protection and advice alongside 24/7 telephonic support, covering everything from issuing written warnings and disciplinary charge sheets to chairing hearings. The practice operates alongside sister divisions covering recruitment, health and safety, HR support and an HR academy. Based in Eldorette, Pretoria, WHM Labour Law Advisors suits employers wanting affordable, ongoing labour law protection rather than ad hoc legal fees only when a dispute arises.

The Woolworths Midrand Distribution Centre is a large distribution and logistics facility supporting Woolworths' supply chain, handling the movement and storage of merchandise rather than functioning as a conventional retail store. Woolworths describes the facility as approximately 78,000 square metres in size, making it one of the larger nodes in the retailer's logistics network.

Its sustainability measures include natural lighting and intelligent lighting controls to cut electricity use, recycled heat recovery, solar thermal hot water, and energy-efficient refrigeration technologies suited to handling perishable stock at scale. The centre serves Woolworths' retail and supply-chain operations, supporting the distribution of merchandise to stores and other parts of the business. Based at 289 Olievenhoutbosch Road, Louwlardia, the Woolworths Midrand Distribution Centre forms part of the infrastructure that keeps Woolworths stores supplied, rather than a site the public would visit directly.

Wrapsa Packaging & Manufacturing has operated in Hennopspark since 1983, when it was one of the first businesses in South Africa to offer third-party pharmaceutical manufacturing and packing services. That pioneering start has grown into a GMP-compliant operation offering manufacturing, packaging and laboratory support for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical clients.

The company accepts raw materials and packaging components on either a firm or consignment basis, and assists clients with medicine registration and validation work alongside its core manufacturing and packing services. Its team has also tracked emerging trends such as pectin-based, clean-label gummies, helping brands manufacture their own custom nutraceutical ranges. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, Wrapsa suits pharmaceutical and nutraceutical brands needing a contract manufacturer that can handle production, packaging and regulatory support under one roof.

XContent Business Solutions, based in Centurion, is a Microsoft cloud partner offering a set of tools built around growing a business through intelligent cloud transformation. Its CloudSource product gives clients an AI-enhanced, single-pane-of-glass dashboard for managing and reporting across their Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, while eKard is a digital business persona and digital card designed to amplify a professional's brand and interactions.

The company's Amplifi 365 is positioned as a low-cost CRM for businesses wanting to understand their customers better, alongside its XCPIM product and published case studies showing how clients have used its tools. Based in Bronberrik, Centurion, XContent Business Solutions suits businesses already invested in Microsoft 365 who want more value from that investment through tailored dashboards, identity tools and a simpler CRM, rather than adopting a completely separate software stack.

African Human Logistics, based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, was founded in 2007 to establish a local base for Quartex Software sales, implementation, training, technical support and after-sales service across Africa. The company holds the sole rights to market, sell and support the Quartex suite on the continent as well as in Mauritius and Madagascar, giving it a defined, exclusive role in the regional software market.

Quartex itself is an international, browser and mobile-capable workforce logistics platform covering safety, competence, compliance, health and environmental obligations, adopted as a benchmark solution for high-risk and complex operations across mining, energy and government sectors, among more than 180 enterprise clients. Based in Centurion, African Human Logistics suits organisations in retail, mining, manufacturing, telecommunications, aviation and construction needing a single system to manage workforce safety and compliance obligations.

Africlock develops and supplies time-and-attendance, payroll and diesel-control systems, combining hardware and software for employee clocking, attendance management, payroll-related functions and diesel monitoring. A mobile app extends this to time-and-attendance functionality via smartphone, letting staff clock in and out away from a fixed terminal.

The company states it has operated since 1989 and has grown to more than 3,500 clients, reflecting a long track record in workforce-management technology. It serves businesses and organisations needing employee time-and-attendance management, payroll integration or diesel-control systems across a range of industries. Based at 1009 Wilhelm Road, Eldoraigne, Centurion, Africlock suits employers wanting a single supplier for clocking, payroll-linked attendance data and fuel-use monitoring rather than separate systems for each.

Amantle Property Management is a residential property rental and management company based in Eloffsdal, letting and administering rental properties across a wide spread of Pretoria suburbs, including Arcadia, Capital Park, Erasmuskloof, Mayville, Pretoria Central, Pretoria East, Pretoria North and Sunnyside. The company markets its available rental stock directly to prospective tenants rather than relying solely on third-party listing sites.

To fill vacancies quickly in specific developments, Amantle has run move-in incentives such as a reduced or waived first month's rent for tenants who sign before a set date, alongside standard deposit and administration fee arrangements elsewhere in its portfolio. Based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, Amantle Property Management suits landlords across these suburbs wanting a management company that actively markets vacant units rather than simply listing and waiting.

Anaprop Property Management, based in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, offers a comprehensive range of property development and management services built around two main areas: asset management and development and project management. Its asset management work includes market research, site evaluations and feasibility studies, conceptualisation and design functionality, and engagement with national tenants to secure strong outcomes for a property.

On the development side, Anaprop appoints and coordinates professional project teams, manages tenant coordination and administration, and strategically appoints contractors to ensure projects are executed efficiently and to a high standard. Based in Centurion, Anaprop Property Management suits property owners and developers needing a single company to manage a property from initial feasibility study through to ongoing tenant administration, rather than engaging separate specialists for each stage.

ARINT Consulting Services South Africa is the local arm of ARINT, an international professional engineering and technical SHEQ services company originally formed in Lyon, France, in 2002, with its South African head office in Centurion. The firm's clients are essentially large international companies, service organisations and utilities, with projects spanning the African, Asian, European and North American continents.

Its engineers and technical specialists work across auditing of operations and maintenance activities, decommissioning plans, physical asset management and reliability engineering, project management, and risk engineering using techniques such as FMECA, HAZOP and What-If studies, alongside ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certification support. ARINT also engineers green energy power stations spanning nuclear, solar and wind. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, ARINT suits large organisations and utilities needing specialist SHEQ and asset-management engineering rather than general consulting engineering.

Aroma Gourmet Coffee Roastery operates as a cafe with its own in-store coffee roastery, serving espresso and specialty coffee alongside breakfast, lunch and brunch menus. Customers can also buy coffee beans roasted on site to take home, alongside baked goods such as croissants and muffins.

The cafe serves coffee drinkers, breakfast and lunch customers, and takeaway customers looking for freshly roasted coffee rather than a mass-produced blend. Based at Florents Heights, 255 Lynnwood Road, on the corner of Pienaar Street in Brooklyn, Pretoria, Aroma Gourmet Coffee Roastery suits cafe visitors wanting to watch, smell and taste coffee roasted on the same premises where it is served, in a setting geared toward a relaxed breakfast or lunch rather than a quick takeaway counter alone.

Arrie Nel Annlin Pharmacy is a branch of the Arrie Nel Pharmacy Group operating in Annlin, Pretoria, part of a group built around the commitment of putting the patient's family first. Alongside standard dispensing and over-the-counter services, the group runs a Family Clinics division and its own warehousing operation, and offers a We-Care Loyalty programme along with a store credit application for regular customers.

The pharmacy keeps an emergency contact line available outside normal hours for urgent medical queries, reflecting a group-wide emphasis on accessibility alongside everyday pharmacy service. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturdays from 8am to 2pm and Sundays from 9am to midday, Arrie Nel Annlin Pharmacy suits Annlin residents wanting a pharmacy backed by a larger group's clinic and loyalty network rather than an independent, standalone store.

Arrow Park is an industrial and logistics development providing modern warehouse and distribution facilities within the Samrand development, offering large warehouse and office accommodation under one roof. Its Phase 2 building, an 11,145 square metre warehouse and office facility, forms part of the park's final development phase.

The development offers 24-hour access and direct connectivity to both the N1 and R101, putting tenants within easy reach of the Pretoria-Johannesburg corridor. It serves businesses needing industrial warehouse, distribution, logistics and associated office space in a single, secured development. Based at 60 Rietspruit Road, Samrand, Arrow Park suits logistics and distribution operators wanting warehouse space with round-the-clock access and strong road connectivity rather than a converted or ad hoc industrial site.

items.reason: Confirmed only as a business-management consultant at 937 Francis Baard Street, Arcadia, Pretoria. The detailed claims in the current description (taxi-industry-owned energy infrastructure, banking and fintech solutions) could not be independently substantiated from any reliable current source: the business's own website (ashleypaulse.com) shows an 'Account Suspended' hosting error on every page, and search results returned only unrelated song-lyric pages. Kept deferred rather than publishing a thin or generic description built only from the address and category.

items.description:
Backyard Pots and Plants, in Rietfontein, supplies plant-related products for hobbyists, backyard growers, nurseries and growers of various scales, trading under the motto "let us grow together." Its online catalogue covers grow bags in a wide range of sizes, round and square plastic pots and matching saucers, plastic CD bowls, window boxes, vacuum pots and growing mediums, all priced and orderable directly from the site.

Orders are shipped nationally through Pudo at a set rate plus a small per-box fee, with other couriers available on request, and payment is only taken by bank transfer or EFT once a quotation has been issued, so buyers are asked to check their order carefully before confirming since returns are not offered. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, Backyard Pots and Plants suits both home gardeners buying a few pots and commercial growers and nurseries ordering in bulk.

Beluga Deere Surveys, in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, was established in 1988, trading previously as AJK Surveys, and is run as a father-and-son team that combines long-standing surveying knowledge with current survey technology. The practice offers a turnkey survey service, assisting clients at various phases of a project with a bespoke approach rather than a fixed, one-size package.

The team keeps up with changing laws and practices affecting land surveying and land ownership, and takes part in professional associations and continued education through workshops and seminars. Its equipment includes GPS and GNSS positioning, 3D laser scanning and digital photography, alongside traditional surveying instruments when the situation calls for them. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, Beluga Deere Surveys suits clients wanting a long-established, technically current survey practice for contour and boundary work.

Berry Astrapak MARCOM is a plastic-packaging manufacturer specialising in thin-walled injection-moulded packaging, including tubs, containers, lids and cups for dairy applications. Its range extends to jars, closures, tubes, bottles, roll-on components and other packaging for personal care, home care, cosmetic, food and industrial markets, supported by printing and in-mould labelling and decorative solutions.

The company serves dairy, food, personal-care, home-care, cosmetic, automotive-lubricant and industrial-chemical manufacturers needing rigid plastic packaging components produced to recognised quality and safety standards. Its Rosslyn facility holds accreditations including FSSC 22000, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, covering food safety and environmental management. Based at 100 Pepler Street, Rosslyn, Pretoria, Berry Astrapak MARCOM suits manufacturers across these sectors needing a packaging partner able to combine moulding, closures and decorative finishing within one supply chain.

Best Enough Trading & Projects, founded in 2010 and based in Amandasig, is a 100% Black-owned, Level 1 B-BBEE civil and mechanical engineering contractor working across all nine South African provinces. Its road construction arm covers upgrading, rehabilitation, asphalt surfacing, appurtenant works and professional road markings, while its civil engineering division handles water reticulation, bulk earthworks, sewer construction and site preparation using GPS-guided machinery for precision grading and soil stability.

The company's project management team focuses on meticulous planning, scheduling and execution, aiming to deliver every project on time, within budget and to agreed quality and safety standards. Based in Amandasig, Pretoria, Best Enough Trading & Projects suits municipal, industrial and private sector clients across South Africa needing an established, transformation-focused contractor for road and civil infrastructure work.

Bidvest Panalpina Logistics operates as part of Bidvest International Logistics, a transport and logistics group with roots dating back to 1910 and now spanning 250 offices in 120 countries. In South Africa the group employs around 1,800 people and runs 17 warehouses countrywide, holding Level 1 B-BBEE contributor status and providing air freight, ocean freight, road freight, warehousing, supply chain engineering and customs brokerage services.

Its industry solutions are built around specific sectors, including automotive, chemicals, consumer, retail and fashion, defence and aerospace, and healthcare, reflecting more than a century of experience adapting supply chains to different kinds of cargo and compliance needs. Based in the Rosslyn industrial area, Bidvest Panalpina Logistics suits manufacturers and importers in these sectors needing an established international freight and logistics partner with a genuine local footprint.

Bigtime Strategic Group is a diversified group with interests spanning information and communications technology, aviation, insurance, financial services, agriculture and events management, with LinkedIn currently categorising the group within IT services and IT consulting. That spread of interests gives it a presence across several unrelated sectors rather than a single core line of business.

As a privately held group headquartered in Pretoria, Bigtime Strategic Group serves organisations and customers across its ICT, aviation, insurance, financial-services, agriculture and events-related interests. Based at 43 Ingersol Road, Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Bigtime Strategic Group suits clients and partners looking for a locally headquartered group with reach across multiple industries rather than a single-sector specialist supplier.

BrandXtreme, born in Wapadrand in 1997 as a small company, has grown over more than 25 years into a graphic and web design, printing, branding and signage business serving small, medium and large businesses. Its approach centres on getting to know each client well enough to unite their business objectives with intelligent, tailored creative and branding solutions rather than applying a standard template.

Beyond design and print, BrandXtreme runs a social media management service covering strategy planning, account and profile creation and branding, content creation and publishing, research and analysis, and campaign and community management across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube. Its physical products range from vinyl decals, window sandblasting and vehicle branding to PVC banners, roll-up banners, signboards, light boxes and aluminium clip frames. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, BrandXtreme suits businesses wanting both their branding designed and their social media presence managed by the same team.

Brizoway Construction, based in Erasmusrand, was established in 2008, starting out with renovation projects before developing into a multi-disciplinary construction business. Its first housing project was awarded in 2010 in Soshanguve, Pretoria, marking the start of the large-scale residential building operation the company has become.

Since then, Brizoway has grown rapidly, delivering projects across Pretoria North, Benoni, Olympus, Akasia, Elandspoort, Amandasig, Orchards, Kosmosdal, Tweefontein and Polokwane, building more than 8,000 housing units by the end of 2022 alongside its renovation and remodelling work. Built on principles of quality, on-time delivery and client satisfaction, Brizoway Construction, from its base in Erasmusrand, suits developers and housing authorities needing a contractor experienced at scale, from affordable mass housing to mid- and high-income residential projects.

items.reason: The supplied address (Waterkloof Rand Centre, 45 Buffelsdrift Street & Rigel Avenue, Erasmusrand) is confirmed by current and historical listings, and the cafe-restaurant concept (breakfast, sandwiches, burgers, salads, pasta, platters, coffee, vegetarian/vegan options) is well documented historically. However, Restaurant Guru currently marks this specific branch as permanently closed, while other platforms still show active menus and hours for it -- a genuine unresolved conflict on current trading status. Kept deferred and not published as a currently operating restaurant pending owner/closure review; logged in closed-businesses.json for that review.

items.description:
Capital Craft Beer Academy, at Greenlyn Village Centre in Menlo Park, began life as a craft beer festival held in the shade of the Voortrekker Monument before the festival moved to the Pretoria Botanical Gardens and its organisers opened their own restaurant on the back of its success. The venue's biggest drawcard is its menu of around 210 beers, paired with a food offering that goes well beyond typical pub fare.

Dishes include vegetarian platters with roast vegetables and haloumi skewers, grilled corn on the cob, falafel balls and crudité, alongside heartier options such as the venue's well-known Mean Green Hamburger. A second branch has since opened in Centurion with a stronger family focus. Based in Menlo Park, Pretoria, Capital Craft Beer Academy suits craft beer enthusiasts and casual diners alike, including those who, by their own admission, aren't usually beer drinkers.

Casa Flora Guest House offers an exclusive retreat inside the secure, gated Silver Lakes Golf Estate in Pretoria East, with luxury rooms designed for travellers who prioritise privacy, elegance and strong security. Guests are surrounded by the fairways of the estate's Peter Matkovich-designed golf course and the natural beauty of its lakes and resident wildlife.

Each room combines high-end finishes with a private entrance and climate control, creating a sanctuary that works equally well for a high-stakes corporate retreat, a romantic honeymoon or a relaxing weekend getaway. The guesthouse is positioned close to Pretoria's business hubs and shopping destinations such as Woodlands and Menlyn Maine, along with a range of nearby dining options. Based in Silver Lakes, Pretoria East, Casa Flora Guest House suits upscale leisure and business travellers wanting a secure, personally serviced stay rather than a standard hotel room.

Casablanca Manor is an award-winning wedding, function and conference venue in Donkerhoek, Pretoria East, set in the eastern Magaliesburg range about a 12-minute drive from the city along the N4. The drive in passes through unspoiled bushveld and mountain views before arriving at a venue built around rustic charm and panoramic sunset views.

Its grounds offer several distinct settings, including a Tea Garden, an Indoor Chapel, an Open Air Chapel, dedicated Garden Weddings areas, the Stony Aloe Venue and a Main Reception Venue, with on-site accommodation also available for guests. The venue hosts weddings, milestone birthdays, anniversaries, corporate functions and business gatherings alike. Based in Donkerhoek, Pretoria East, Casablanca Manor suits couples and companies wanting a choice of settings within a single nature-based venue rather than one fixed space.

Cash Crusaders Blu Valley Mall operates second-hand retail and pawn-shop services, buying and selling pre-owned goods such as electronics, appliances and tools, and providing secured cash loans against qualifying items. Customers can therefore either sell items they no longer need or use them as security for a short-term cash loan.

The branch serves consumers looking to buy affordable second-hand goods, sell unwanted items, or obtain a secured loan against eligible possessions, and is confirmed in Blu Valley Mall's own tenant directory as operating within the centre. Based at Blu Valley Mall, Bothrill Avenue, in The Reeds, Centurion, Cash Crusaders Blu Valley Mall suits shoppers in the Rooihuiskraal and The Reeds area wanting a nearby outlet for second-hand goods and pawn-shop finance.

Cavanagh & Richards Attorneys is a law firm headquartered in Centurion's Die Hoewes area, with further branches in Pretoria East, Randburg, Witbank, Middelburg and Cape Town. Its practice covers corporate and commercial law, residential and commercial conveyancing and notarial work, contract and labour law, and litigation, claims and debt collection, giving it a reasonably full-service offering across several unrelated legal disciplines.

The firm also runs CR Properties, a related property division, alongside its core legal practice. Describing itself as efficient, committed and ethical, Cavanagh & Richards positions its attorneys as specialists able to read the fine print on contract and labour matters as well as handle straightforward property transfers. Based in Centurion, the firm suits individuals and businesses needing conveyancing, labour law advice or debt recovery support from a firm with a multi-branch Gauteng and Mpumalanga footprint.

CCBSA Pretoria West is one of eleven manufacturing facilities operated by Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa (CCBSA), a company formed as a legal entity in July 2016 from the merger of six non-alcoholic ready-to-drink bottling operations. CCBSA is a subsidiary of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa and operates as a bottler for The Coca-Cola Company, employing more than 5,600 people across seven sales territories nationally.

The group holds Level 1 B-BBEE status and maintains close to 369,000 coolers in the market along with 28 local distribution partnerships, reflecting the scale of its national bottling and distribution network. Located on Market Street in Booysens, Pretoria West, this facility forms part of that national production footprint. Based in Pretoria, CCBSA Pretoria West is one node in the group's wider manufacturing and distribution operation.

Centurion Letting & Sales is a real estate agency in Wierdapark, Centurion, specialising in residential, commercial and industrial property sales and letting with more than 25 years of experience behind it. The agency describes itself as having helped more than 5,000 clients, supported by a team of more than ten property area experts across its coverage area.

Its commercial offering covers office space, retail units and investment properties, while its industrial division serves manufacturing, warehousing and distribution businesses looking for suitable premises, alongside the agency's residential sales and letting work. Agents use area profiles, calculators and property email alerts to support clients through the buying, selling or letting process. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, Centurion Letting & Sales suits property owners and tenants across the residential, commercial and industrial markets alike.

Chas Everitt Centurion Estate Agency is a franchise office of the Chas Everitt International Property Group, a family-owned South African real estate company that has been helping people move for almost half a century. The agency offers property valuations based on comparative market analysis and current trends, along with support listing a home online through a dedicated property consultant.

Beyond straightforward sales, Chas Everitt's wider services include currency transfers through Currencies Direct for international clients, bond origination, conveyancing support, advice on sectional title property, and landlord information for those renting out a property, alongside its Chas Cares community initiative. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, Chas Everitt Centurion Estate Agency suits buyers, sellers, landlords and international clients wanting one agency to handle the sale and the surrounding financial and legal steps.

Chauke tree felling provides professional tree-felling and tree-service work, including cutting trees and the controlled lowering of cut sections using ropes to protect property and surrounding structures. This rope-based approach suits trees standing in tight gardens or close to buildings, driveways and overhead lines, where a tree cannot simply be dropped in one piece.

The business serves property owners and customers needing tree-felling or related tree-service work in Centurion and the surrounding areas, and operates 24 hours a day for call-outs, with a listing in a current Centurion tree-felling directory. Based at 2 Lawson's Place, Centurion, Chauke tree felling suits homeowners and businesses needing a dependable, locally based team for tree removal rather than general garden maintenance work alone.

Check Your Business Value, based in Elardus Park, gives small and medium-sized business owners access to chartered accountants, tax experts and lawyers with more than 13 years of combined experience valuing businesses and drafting business plans for the South African market. The firm uses a combination of valuation methods suited specifically to local market conditions, aiming for accuracy that generic international approaches may miss.

Its team structure is built around three disciplines: chartered accountants who check the underlying facts, figures and risks of a business, tax experts who handle tax-related queries, planning and strategy, and lawyers who ensure the legal side of a sale or valuation is handled properly with no loopholes. A free valuation calculator is available on the company's website for an initial estimate. Based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, Check Your Business Value suits owners buying, selling or planning the future of an SME who need an affordable, locally relevant valuation.

Chimu Log Homes, trading as CHIMU Construction and based in Amandasig, is a family-owned business with more than two decades of hands-on experience designing and manufacturing wooden and Nutec structures. Its product range covers ready-to-assemble Wendy houses and cabins, with the option to customise an existing design or have a completely custom structure produced to suit a specific need.

Because Wendy houses can typically be built without a permit, they are popular as home offices, hobby rooms, guest cabins or simple storage space, and the company notes they are especially favoured at campsites, resorts and guest ranches for their warmth and the smell of real wood. Based in Amandasig, Pretoria, Chimu Log Homes suits homeowners, resorts and campsite operators wanting a durable, budget-friendly wooden or Nutec structure built to last rather than a basic prefab shed.

Chrome Catering Equipment, trading from Montana Park as the sole South African importer of the ChromeCater brand, supplies commercial kitchens with equipment ranging from spiral inverter mixers in several sizes to can and cup sealers, butchery and deli parts such as replacement band-saw blades, and combo deals packaged for businesses starting up or upgrading a kitchen. Its online shop lists current pricing and stock for each item, making it straightforward for a buyer to compare options before ordering.

The company positions its offering as reliable, affordable and durable, built around supplying both the equipment itself and the ongoing consumables a commercial kitchen needs to keep running. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to midday, Chrome Catering Equipment suits restaurants, caterers and butcheries in Montana Park and the surrounding area needing one supplier for equipment, parts and consumables.

CJLM Electroplating, based in Hermanstad, has more than 40 years of experience applying metal finishes including brass, copper, nickel, chrome, hard chrome and zinc plating, as well as black oxide treatments, to a wide range of parts. Alongside standard plating work, the company has built a niche in skull plating, a specialised process applying nickel or copper plating to animal skull specimens for trophy hunting, anthropology and decorative or artistic purposes.

Its additional services include polishing of brass, copper, aluminium and stainless steel, gun coating, vibratory finishing of small parts, stripping old plating, paint or powder coating, de-rusting metal parts and glass bead blasting. Based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, CJLM Electroplating suits workshops, collectors and hobbyists needing specialised metal finishing work that goes well beyond a standard chrome-plating shop.

Compass Land Surveyors, in Waterkloof Glen, is a professional land surveying firm built around cadastral surveys: the accurate demarcation of property boundaries, beacons and servitudes, and the subdivision and consolidation of land parcels registered within South Africa's Deeds Office system. That work spans township general plans, property subdivision and consolidation surveys, lease area surveys, servitude surveys, proclamation area surveys, public place and street closures, and beacon relocation, replacement and certification.

The firm also establishes control survey networks, the fundamental horizontal and vertical position data that other surveys and construction projects rely on for accuracy. Based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, Compass Land Surveyors suits developers, conveyancers and property owners needing precise, legally recognised survey work for subdivisions, consolidations or boundary disputes rather than a general-purpose surveying service.

Compleo, based at Byls Bridge Office Park in Doringkloof, Centurion, supplies Xerox production and office printing equipment, including the CX950 and CX951 colour production printers and the Xerox AltaLink C8200 series of colour multifunction printers.
